edition: Health news digest – Friday, 27 November 2026 – Afternoon edition

items.title: Air pollution mechanism that triggers asthma discovered
items.summary: A King's College London and Cardiff University study in eBioMedicine found that metal particles in air pollution activate the calcium-sensing receptor on airway cells, triggering inflammation linked to asthma attacks and possibly COPD exacerbations. The work combined laboratory models with population health data and identified the receptor as a potential drug target.

items.title: Don't Lead With 'Did You Smoke?': Lung Cancer Advice for Oncology Nurses
items.summary: Lung screening researcher Lisa Carter-Bawa discusses how AI could flag patients eligible for low-dose CT lung cancer screening while nurses remain the human in the loop. The article also covers non-stigmatising ways to ask about smoking history and cost barriers to follow-up after screening.
